    Research interest Code Contact

    Ritika Aggarwal     		I am interested in studying the how IDR regions of E3 ligase enzymes attract the target substrates. My particular interest is in HUWE1 ligase, being promiscuous in nature, I want to understand what is the mechanism of actions of binding to multiple substrates using all atomistic, coarse grain simulations and machine learning approaches.
